sn52.5:1.3: “Reverend Anuruddha, what things should a bhikkhu who is an adept enter and dwell in?”
sn52.5:1.4: “Reverend Sāriputta, a bhikkhu who is an adept should enter and dwell in the four kinds of mindfulness meditation.
sn52.5:1.6: It’s when a bhikkhu meditates by observing an aspect of the body—ardently aware and comprehending, without craving and aversion towards the world
sn52.5:1.7: They meditate observing an aspect of feelings …
sn52.5:1.9: principles—ardently aware and comprehending, without craving and aversion towards the world
sn52.5:1.10: A bhikkhu who is an adept should enter and dwell in these four kinds of mindfulness meditation.”
